lines: Punapi attano paramatthato nhātakabhāvameva vibhāvetuṃ “ogayhā”ti osānagāthamāha.
Sabbapāpaṃ pavāhayinti anavasesaṃ pāpamalaṃ pakkhālesiṃ, ariyamaggajalapavāhanena paramatthanhātako ahosiṃ.
Tato eva tisso vijjā ajjhagamiṃ, kataṃ buddhassa sāsananti vuttatthameva.

before.title: Gayākassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Ayampi purimabuddhesu katādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinanto ito ekatiṃse kappe sikhissa bhagavato kāle kulagehe nibbattitvā viññutaṃ patto nissaraṇajjhāsayatāya gharāvāsaṃ pahāya tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā araññāyatane assamaṃ kāretvā vanamūlaphalāhāro vasati.
Tena ca samayena bhagavā eko adutiyo tassa assamasamīpena gacchati.
So bhagavantaṃ disvā pasannamānaso upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā ekamantaṃ ṭhito velaṃ oloketvā manoharāni kolaphalāni satthu upanesi.

So tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddhuppāde brāhmaṇakule nibbattitvā vayappatto nissaraṇajjhāsayatāya gharāvāsaṃ pahāya tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā dvīhi tāpasasatehi saddhiṃ gayāyaṃ viharati.
Gayāyaṃ vasanato hissa kassapagottatāya ca gayākassapoti samaññā ahosi.
So bhagavatā saddhiṃ parisāya ehibhikkhūpasampadaṃ datvā ādittapariyāyadesanāya (mahāva. 54) ovadiyamāno arahatte patiṭṭhāsi.

before.title: Gayākassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Tattha paṭhamagāthāya tāva ayaṃ saṅkhepattho – pāto sūriyuggamanavelāyaṃ, majjhanhikaṃ majjhanhavelāyaṃ, sāyaṃ sāyanhavelāyanti divasassa tikkhattuṃ tayo vāre ahaṃ udakaṃ otariṃ ogāhiṃ.

Otaranto ca sohaṃ na yattha katthaci yadā vā tadā vā otariṃ, atha kho gayāya mahājanassa “pāpapavāhana”nti abhisammate gayātitthe, gayaphagguyā gayāphaggunāmake phaggunīmāsassa uttaraphaggunīnakkhatte anusaṃvaccharaṃ udakorohanamanuyutto ahosinti.

before.title: Gayākassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Idāni tadā yenādhippāyena udakorohanamanuyuttaṃ, taṃ dassetuṃ “yaṃ mayā”ti gāthamāha.
“yaṃ mayā pubbe ito aññāsu jātīsu pāpakammaṃ upacitaṃ.
Taṃ idāni idha gayātitthe imissā ca gayāphagguyā iminā udakorohanena pavāhemi apanemi vikkhālemī”ti.

before.title: Gayākassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Dhammena ca atthena ca sahitakoṭṭhāsaṃ, ādito majjhato pariyosānato ca dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ atthūpasaṃhitaṃ suṭṭhu ekantena niyyānikaṃ katvā bhāsitaṃ vācaṃ sammāsambuddhavacanaṃ sutvā tena pakāsitaṃ paramatthabhāvena tacchabhāvato tathaṃ yathārahaṃ pavattinivattiupāyabhāve byabhicārābhāvato yāthāvakaṃ dukkhādiatthaṃ yoniso upāyena pariññeyyādibhāvena paccavekkhisaṃ “dukkhaṃ pariññeyyaṃ, samudayo pahātabbo, nirodho sacchikātabbo, maggo bhāvetabbo”ti patiavekkhiṃ, ñāṇacakkhunā passiṃ paṭivijjhinti attho.

before.title: Gayākassapattheragāthāvaṇṇanā
lines: Ninhātasabbapāpomhīti evaṃ paṭividdhasaccattā eva ariyamaggajalena vikkhālitasabbapāpo amhi.
Tato eva parisuddhakāyasamācāratāya parisuddhavacīsamācāratāya parisuddhamanosamācāratāya payato suci suddho.
